alternatives.reason_rejected: Decisions are informational; warnings are imperative. Agents ignored decisions because they weren't urgent enough to change behavior.
Harder to scan. Dedicated sections with clear hierarchy are more actionable.

context: Benchmark showed near-zero coordination lift despite high tool engagement. The output format wasn't directive enough — agents read it but didn't change behavior.
rationale: Warnings (what NOT to do) are the most behavior-changing signal. Handoffs provide continuation context. Decisions are important but less urgent. Findings are background. This ordering front-loads the most actionable information into the first 500 tokens where agents are most likely to act on it.
summary: Reorder formatForLLM: warnings first, then handoffs, then decisions, then needs, then findings
